-- Step 1: Create the metrics table if it doesn't exist
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS metrics (
    recordregistry character NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    flowstamp timestamp without time zone,
    datasizemb numeric,
    durmin smallint,
    bwidthpct numeric,
    successpct numeric,
    errtally smallint,
    rtrytally smallint,
    transfer_effectiveness_score numeric,
    updated_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Step 2: Populate metrics with existing dataflow records
INSERT INTO metrics (recordregistry, flowstamp, datasizemb, durmin, bwidthpct, successpct, errtally, rtrytally, transfer_effectiveness_score)
SELECT 
    recordregistry,
    flowstamp,
    datasizemb,
    durmin,
    bwidthpct,
    successpct,
    errtally,
    rtrytally,
    CASE 
        WHEN errtally IS NOT NULL AND rtrytally IS NOT NULL THEN 
            ROUND(successpct * (bwidthpct / 100.0) * (1.0 - CAST(errtally AS numeric) / (CAST(errtally AS numeric) + CAST(rtrytally AS numeric) + 1.0)), 4)
        ELSE 
            ROUND(successpct * (bwidthpct / 100.0), 4)
    END AS transfer_effectiveness_score
FROM dataflow
ON CONFLICT (recordregistry) DO UPDATE SET
    flowstamp = EXCLUDED.flowstamp,
    datasizemb = EXCLUDED.datasizemb,
    durmin = EXCLUDED.durmin,
    bwidthpct = EXCLUDED.bwidthpct,
    successpct = EXCLUDED.successpct,
    errtally = EXCLUDED.errtally,
    rtrytally = EXCLUDED.rtrytally,
    transfer_effectiveness_score = EXCLUDED.transfer_effectiveness_score,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

-- Step 3: Create function to update metrics on dataflow changes
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_metrics_on_dataflow()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO metrics (recordregistry, flowstamp, datasizemb, durmin, bwidthpct, successpct, errtally, rtrytally, transfer_effectiveness_score)
    VALUES (
        NEW.recordregistry,
        NEW.flowstamp,
        NEW.datasizemb,
        NEW.durmin,
        NEW.bwidthpct,
        NEW.successpct,
        NEW.errtally,
        NEW.rtrytally,
        CASE 
            WHEN NEW.errtally IS NOT NULL AND NEW.rtrytally IS NOT NULL THEN 
                ROUND(NEW.successpct * (NEW.bwidthpct / 100.0) * (1.0 - CAST(NEW.errtally AS numeric) / (CAST(NEW.errtally AS numeric) + CAST(NEW.rtrytally AS numeric) + 1.0)), 4)
            ELSE 
                ROUND(NEW.successpct * (NEW.bwidthpct / 100.0), 4)
        END
    )
    ON CONFLICT (recordregistry) DO UPDATE SET
        flowstamp = EXCLUDED.flowstamp,
        datasizemb = EXCLUDED.datasizemb,
        durmin = EXCLUDED.durmin,
        bwidthpct = EXCLUDED.bwidthpct,
        successpct = EXCLUDED.successpct,
        errtally = EXCLUDED.errtally,
        rtrytally = EXCLUDED.rtrytally,
        transfer_effectiveness_score = EXCLUDED.transfer_effectiveness_score,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

-- Step 4: Create trigger on dataflow table
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS dataflow_metrics_trigger ON dataflow;
CREATE TRIGGER dataflow_metrics_trigger
AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON dataflow
FOR EACH ROW
EXECUTE FUNCTION update_metrics_on_dataflow();
